name: r2-rope-ceiling-v4
author: solx-loop
description: H14: the bench's about 7.0 TB/s read+write stream (LDG.128, one-shot, evict_last stores) is the ceiling at L. No memory path tested (256-bit accesses, 1-D bulk rings, one-shot bulk tiles, interleaved or reversed CTA order, plain stores) beats it by 3% at 612 or 2689 MB. So the candidate is r1's kernel unchanged.
